metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: CVE-2026-20316 — Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Exploitation
properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-20316: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) formerly known as Firepower Management Center contains a use of hard-coded password vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to log in to an affected device using a low-privileged account to access sensitive data within the impacted systems.. Product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC)
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-20316" or Message contains "SECURE FIREWALL MANAGEMENT CENTER (FMC)" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
